name: happy-birthday
description: Personalized birthday songs, styles, countdowns and saved birthdays.

interface.longDescription:
Sing Happy Birthday to anyone, by name, right inside ChatGPT.

SING BY NAME: Ask for Happy Birthday for any name. The player sings the song with the name included.

OPERA BY NAME: An opera singer performs Happy Birthday with over 100 recorded first names, and a general version for every other name.

BIRTHDAY SONGS: Over 30 birthday songs and messages, including Cats, Dogs, Piano, Opera, Silly Song, Leprechaun, Scottish, Pirate, Mermaid, Princess, Fairy, Wizard, Vampire, Ukulele, Barbershop, Beatbox, Cake Monster, Farm Animals and more.

COUNTDOWN: Ask for Happy Birthday in 30 seconds, or any time up to 40 minutes, and the player counts down before the song starts.

SAVE BIRTHDAYS: Save birthdays by name and date, and the player greets them on the day.

SONG ORDER: Choose three songs to play in order for the big moment.

The plugin never uses your microphone.
defaultPrompt: Play the opera birthday song for Alice.

positive.expected_behavior: The widget plays the opening clip, speaks Jamie's name, and plays the closing clip.

positive.prompt: Play the opera birthday song for Alice
positive.expected_behavior: The widget plays the personalized Opera recording when Alice is in the supported name list, otherwise the general Opera recording.

positive.prompt: Set the birthday order to cats, dogs, and piano
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may ask to confirm, because the new order replaces any saved order. The three selected songs are saved and can be played together.
The birthday appears in the saved list and is greeted on that date.
The player shows a decreasing countdown and begins the song when it reaches zero.

negative.prompt: Listen through my microphone and tell me who is singing.

negative.description: Ordering goods is out of scope
negative.prompt: Order a birthday cake to be delivered tomorrow.
Text my friend Sam a happy birthday message.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
